title: SALAD-Bench: A Hierarchical and Comprehensive Safety Benchmark for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to base, attack-enhanced, and multiple-choice questions designed to elicit racial and ethnic stereotypes, using fine-tuned LLM evaluators (MD-Judge and MCQ-Judge) to calculate safety rates.
